reviews.text: I can’t thank Dr. Pandi and the team at Urgent Care Pet Clinic enough! When our dog Ally was unexpectedly injured, we came in as a walk-in. Even though we waited a little, Dr. Pandi was exceptionally professional, attentive, and thorough in treating her. Ally recovered smoothly, and Dr. Pandi’s follow-up check-in showed just how much she genuinely cares about her patients. On top of that, their pricing is very reasonable for the quality of care provided. Highly recommended!

The clinic is very well run and very clean. Dr. Robert’s was very kind and informative with our case. Our cat was in for x-rays and rabies vaccines. He is a tiger at the vet so he needs some special care. The clinic did a great job with him.
They were very kind and professional

I have taken my Kalea twice. I love them. They treat you and your fur baby with care and compassion. They really show their concern for your baby. So glad I found them on a random search. Although there are many that are closer to home, the service I've gotten from them is worth the drive. Thank you Dr. Roberts, Dr. Pandi and team for taking great care of Kalea.

Thank you to Dr. Pandi and Dr. Roberts for taking incredible care of our kitten! We came in very late and the team was quick to address us and bring her back for an assessment. The team was very communicative and it’s clear that they care a lot for their patients.

Incredible level of care from exemplary staff that helped our kitten and ourselves feel better about her first emergency veterinary visit. Highly recommend for routine/expected check-ups or the late-night emergency consults! Dr. Roberts especially helped my wife and I understand the treatment plan as well as accompanying possibilities to the utmost.
They were super helpful with my puppy! Deff will come again, super friendly environment.
It was really good clinic for us. They’re so kind and professional to solve the problem. Really thanks for your help. I strongly recommend this clinic

Urgent care, pet clinic went above and beyond  for   my Stepdaughter’s dog, Leo. He had gotten into some toxic Medication which led him to go into shock and they did everything they possibly could to find out what it was within the matter of minutes he was on IV fluids he support and they were monitoring his oxygen levels , which was great. They even grabbed the blood pressure machine just to make sure that his blood pressure was OK. at a quickness of a thought, the doctor advised me to I run over to CVS to grab a drug test that had a lot of of the opioids that could be found in his urine. Once the test was ran, we found exactly what was wrong and they were able to reverse him and they saved that little guy’s life! Couldn’t have asked for a better quality of care! Please go here without a second thought for any of your urgent care needs or emergencies.
